caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular segment of a textile or woven pattern set against a plain, off-white background. The design is comprised of geometric and floral motifs made up of three main colors: a medium brown background, bright red, and bold blue. At the top left, there is a large stylized blue flower with radiating petals, while the lower portion shows a red, leaf-like motif with multiple offshoots, bordered by blue, spiky, fern-like leaves. Running vertically along the right edge, there is a band with a zigzag blue pattern on a red background, and two thinner vertical lines separating areas of the composition. The patterns appear to be arranged in a grid-like manner, suggesting a woven or tapestry effect created by a crosshatch of fine lines. The drawing is signed in small writing toward the lower right of the rectangular section on the plain background.
title: Coverlet
